_note: Machine-readable map of gamepress. An AI picks a track, reads its doc, runs its steps. Shared tools serve every track.

shared.purpose: Research, build/scaffold, headless test, scripted gameplay video, store images.

demo.needs: git push access to the demo-page repo; no accounts or keys
demo.purpose: Local/browser-only demo page (GitHub Pages): free playable web games with thumbnails, search, no store.

web-store.needs: itch butler key, CrazyGames portal login, Steamworks app ($100), YouTube OAuth: owner-provided, other agent implements uploads
web-store.purpose: Web build (HTML5) for itch.io and CrazyGames, desktop wrap + store page for Steam, Shorts on YouTube.

roblox.needs: Open Cloud API key in macOS Keychain (scopes: universe.place.write, luau-execution-session), universe + place ids
roblox.purpose: Roblox experiences: build in Studio, headless Luau tests, safe publish, retention audit.
